title: Road Hazard Protection Out-of-Area Tow Allowance
content:
**Out-of-area tow under Road Hazard Protection.**

1. **Tow allowance.** The tow rate is 1, and the tow allowance is the plan's tow cap times the tow rate, plus every uplift that applies to it, rounded half up to the cent.
2. **Out-of-area tow reimbursement.** The tow allowance less every deduction that applies to it, kept within every limit that applies to it; it is then rounded half up to the cent and held at 0.00 or more.
3. **Payment and calls.** It is paid to the tender the certificate was bought with, and the certificate's remaining roadside calls go down by one.

| Plan | Tow cap on the roadside line card | Tow allowance with no uplift |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection | 125.00 | 125.00 |
| Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection | 100.00 | 100.00 |

**Hypothetical example.** A Life-of-Tread certificate with 3 roadside calls remaining, bought with a debit card, with no uplift, deduction or limit applying: an out-of-area tow is reimbursed 125.00 to the debit card and the certificate is left with 2 calls.
